objectives.en: Calculate mass defect and binding energy
Interpret the binding energy per nucleon curve

narration.en: Weigh 8 protons and 8 neutrons separately, then weigh an oxygen-16 nucleus. The nucleus is lighter. Where did the mass go?
narration.kn: 8 ಪ್ರೋಟಾನ್ ಮತ್ತು 8 ನ್ಯೂಟ್ರಾನ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ತೂಗಿ, ನಂತರ ಆಕ್ಸಿಜನ್-16 ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಸ್ ತೂಗಿ. ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಸ್ ಹಗುರ. ದ್ರವ್ಯರಾಶಿ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಹೋಯಿತು?

body.en: Einstein showed that mass and energy are equivalent: $E = mc^2$, and $1$ u corresponds to $931.5$ MeV. A nucleus is lighter than its separate nucleons by the mass defect $\Delta M = [Zm_p + (A-Z)m_n] - M$. The binding energy $E_b = \Delta M c^2$ is the energy released when the nucleus forms, or needed to pull it apart.
body.kn: E = mc²; 1 u = 931.5 MeV. ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಸ್ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಾನ್‌ಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ΔM ರಷ್ಟು ಹಗುರ (ದ್ರವ್ಯರಾಶಿ ಕೊರತೆ). ಬಂಧನ ಶಕ್ತಿ E_b = ΔMc².

title.en: Board: where binding energy comes from

narration.en: Let us weigh a nucleus against its separate nucleons and find the missing mass.

say.en: Two protons and two neutrons weigh more apart than when bound as helium-4. The missing mass is the mass defect.
The binding energy is the mass defect times c squared.
For helium-4 the mass defect is 0.0304 u, so the binding energy is 28.3 MeV, about 7.07 MeV per nucleon.
Binding energy per nucleon rises quickly, peaks near iron-56 at about 8.8 MeV, and falls slowly for heavy nuclei. Light nuclei release energy by fusing; heavy ones by splitting.

narration.en: Binding energy per nucleon rises fast for light nuclei, peaks near A = 56 (iron, about 8.8 MeV) and falls slowly for heavy ones. So joining light nuclei (fusion) or splitting heavy ones (fission) moves towards the peak and releases energy. Curve: semi-empirical mass formula; dots: measured values.

caption.en: Binding energy per nucleon rises fast for light nuclei, peaks near A = 56 (iron, about 8.8 MeV) and falls slowly for heavy ones. So joining light nuclei (fusion) or splitting heavy ones (fission) moves towards the peak and releases energy. Curve: semi-empirical mass formula; dots: measured values.
caption.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಾನ್ ಬಂಧನ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಹಗುರ ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಸ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಏರಿ, A = 56 (ಕಬ್ಬಿಣ, ಸುಮಾರು 8.8 MeV) ಬಳಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ, ಭಾರವಾದವುಗಳಿಗೆ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಗುರಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸುವುದು (ಸಮ್ಮಿಲನ) ಅಥವಾ ಭಾರವನ್ನು ಒಡೆಯುವುದು (ವಿದಳನ) ಶಕ್ತಿ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The binding energy per nucleon $E_{bn} = E_b/A$ measures how tightly a nucleus is held. It is small for light nuclei, nearly constant at about 8 MeV for $30 < A < 170$, peaks at about 8.75 MeV near $A = 56$, and falls to about 7.6 MeV for $A = 238$. So very heavy nuclei release energy by splitting (fission) and very light nuclei by joining (fusion).
body.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಾನ್ ಬಂಧನ ಶಕ್ತಿ A = 56 ಬಳಿ ಸುಮಾರು 8.75 MeV ಗರಿಷ್ಠ. ಭಾರೀ ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಸ್ ವಿದಳನದಿಂದ, ಹಗುರ ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಸ್ ಸಮ್ಮಿಲನದಿಂದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.
